canonicalization: complete validation before bounded generic MLIR print; identity optimize retains all units, operations, order, identities and anchors

functions.anchors: nonempty UTF16 ranges inside source/function/return; concat operator range length1 lies between leaf ranges; expression range encloses leaves/operator
functions.body: one block; entry fuel1 at fn.range; one literal or left/right literals+concat; final return at original return.range
functions.ssa: returned value and ordered concat operands must be those exact reached definitions; no extra/duplicate/detached operations

identity.function: existing SHA256(UTF8(tsfg.function + NUL + sourcePath + NUL + functionName + NUL + unprefixed signature hash))
identity.source: carry explicitly selected validated upstream input/source hashes; C++ verifies Core constraints without claiming Source-facts reconstruction

limitsOfCredit: No String execution, Runtime storage/GC/ABI, formal Source012, native instructions, RF or host witness. Shared legacy stdin/MLIR parsing is not independently resource-certified.

module.functionIds: ordered nonempty array of exact prefixed global String function IDs; matches every emitted func.func exactly
module.profile: all64-or-fewer functions are parameterless String returns; factsVersion1 uniform literal or2 uniform literal-left/literal-right concat

operations.name: tsfg_string.constant
operations.semantics: exact ordered UTF16 code units; never UTF8 replacement or Unicode normalization

operations.name: tsfg_string.concat
operations.semantics: left leaf then right leaf then ordered concat; no evaluation/folding; preserve lone/pair/split surrogate units

type.physicalStorage: opaque; Runtime canonical WTF8/GC/ABI remains separate
